sections.title: Know a host who should be on {{brand.name}}? You both get time free.
sections.lead: Refer another host. They get 60 days free from their first event instead of 30. Once they pay their first {{brand.name}} bill, your next month of {{brand.name}} fees is free.

to.message: Hi {{brand.name}}, I have a question about referring a host.

sections.title: Three steps, and the first one takes a minute.

items.title: Sign in and tell us about them
items.body: Sign in on this page with your {{brand.stores.hostAppName}} number, then send us their name, their Instagram or website, and how you know them.

items.title: They start with 60 days free
items.body: We get in touch and help them set up. Their free trial runs 60 days from their first event, instead of 30.

items.title: They pay, your month is free
items.body: Once they pay their first {{brand.name}} bill, your next month of {{brand.name}} fees is free. Each host you refer who pays earns you another.

sections.title: Who should we talk to?
sections.lead: Tell us the host’s name, their Instagram or website, and how you know them. We’ll reach out, say you sent us, and help them get set up. We never sign anyone up without their say-so. For your free month, sign in above the form with the number you use in {{brand.stores.hostAppName}}.

to.message: Hi {{brand.name}}, I have a question about referring a host.

items.title: For hosts referring hosts
items.body: You need to own a live host page on {{brand.name}}, and be signed in on this page as its owner when you send the referral.

items.title: First referral counts
items.body: If two hosts refer the same host, the first referral we record is the one that counts.

items.title: Before their first event
items.body: The referral has to reach us before their first event. Once their free trial has started, it can’t be added.

items.title: Not your own page
items.body: Referring a page you run yourself, or one run from your phone number, doesn’t count.

items.title: A free month, not cash
items.body: Your reward is a month of {{brand.name}} fees: your next bill after they pay is free. There’s no cash payout.

items.title: It waits for a month you sell
items.body: If you have nothing to pay in the month after they pay, your free month waits for the next month you do.

items.title: They add up
items.body: Each host you refer who pays their first bill earns you another free month.

items.title: Founding hosts keep 90
items.body: A founding host keeps their 90 free days. A referral never shortens a free trial.

items.question: How do I sign in?
items.answer: Tap Sign in with your {{brand.stores.hostAppName}} number, just above the referral form, and enter the code we text you. Use the number you use in {{brand.stores.hostAppName}}. A referral sent signed out still reaches us, but it can’t be credited to you.

items.question: Do I need to be a {{brand.name}} host?
items.answer: For the free month, yes: it’s for hosts who own a page on {{brand.name}}. Anyone can still tell us about a host they love.

items.question: What does the host I refer get?
items.answer: 60 days free from their first event, instead of the usual 30. If they’re a founding host, they keep their 90.

items.question: When is my month free?
items.answer: Once they pay their first {{brand.name}} bill, your next bill is free, whatever you sold that month. Waiting for their first payment keeps the reward for real hosts.

items.question: What if they’d already started on {{brand.name}}?
items.answer: A referral has to reach us before their first event. If they’ve already run one, or another host referred them first, there’s no reward.

items.question: Will you tell the host I referred them?
items.answer: Yes, we’ll say you sent us. If you’d rather we didn’t, tell us when we message you on WhatsApp.

sections.title: Start your own free trial.
sections.lead: Free for 30 days from your first event, or 90 for founding hosts.
